#!/bin/bash
# Managed Inputs ## Data Analyzer javabin creation aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 1800 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
ts=$(date '+%m-%d-%yT%H')
#aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/biodatacatalyst_javabins_data_analyzer_${ts}.tar.gz s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/ aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/${S3_DATA_SET_TAR_NAME} . --no-progress
tar xf ${S3_DATA_SET_TAR_NAME}
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 1800 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` if ($updateStudyMeta) then aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/data/metadata_new_search.json metadata.json --no-progress fi if ($updateStigvars) then aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/data/conceptsToRemove.txt . --no-progress fi unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 1800 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
tar cf biodatacatalyst_javabins_data_analyzer_${ts}.tar columnMeta.csv *.javabin encryption_key metadata.json conceptsToRemove.txt
aws s3 cp biodatacatalyst_javabins_data_analyzer_${ts}.tar s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/ --no-progress
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
#aws s3 cp columnMeta.csv s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv
echo "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/biodatacatalyst_javabins_data_analyzer_${ts}.tar" > data_analyzer_javabin_file_name.txt
